$comment: Accepted advisories for scripts/audit-check.mjs (pnpm audit --prod, gate >= high). Every entry needs the GHSA id, the package, the reason it is acceptable and an expiry date: after that date CI goes red again until the entry is renewed with a fresh justification or the dependency is fixed. Entries below the gate are listed for documentation only.

entries.reason: Fix requires @apollo/server 5 (express 5 / @as-integrations/express adapter migration). CSRF prevention and a CORS allowlist are already enforced in apps/api/src/server.ts.
express 4.22 pins qs ~6.14; the fixed line (6.15/6.16) is only reachable with express 5. The API parses JSON bodies (GraphQL) — qs only handles the query string of REST routes.
Same as GHSA-q8mj-m7cp-5q26: qs pinned by express 4.

Our own uuid is >= 11.1.1; the remaining copies (8.3.2 / 9.0.1 / 11.1.0) are pinned by @apollo/server and @azure/msal-node. The flaw is in v3/v5/v6 with a caller-supplied buffer; those libraries only generate v4 ids.
